title: GateMate Bootstrap 'unspecified' Verdict Root-Cause Diagnostic
honest_verdict: complete: rootcause=script_never_sets_verdict; exp3404 never assigns honest_verdict and build_result() does not auto-populate it, so the emitted artifact has no verdict field -> reconciler reads 'unspecified'.
recommended_fix: Add an explicit honest_verdict to the Exp 3404 build_result() calls. ExperimentTemplate.build_result() does NOT auto-populate honest_verdict, so the script must pass it: e.g. honest_verdict='blocked_gatemate_toolchain_missing' when PnR/flash tools are absent, or honest_verdict='success_gatemate_n16_flashed' on a real flash. Without this, every run emits a verdict-less artifact the reconciler reads as 'unspecified'.
